headline: The A1-01 source is found and bound, and the recurrence edit is now auditionable against the complete work rather than a 31-second window.

independence.reference_recording_consulted: the source IS the reference for this lane; no other recording was consulted

normalisation_note: the retained 31-second witness applies a global true-peak gain; this does not, because the control is untouched and a gain on one side would turn the comparison into a loudness test

owner_pack.assignment_derivation: sha256 over the two render digests; forced by the audio before the pack was built and reproducible from the evidence

blind_strength.leak: the donor region is untouched in both readings, so in the edited file the 2:41 passage returns at 4:15; an attentive end-to-end listen can therefore identify which letter is edited
blind_strength.why_disclosed: an owner who believes a blind is stronger than it is cannot correct for it; the verdict asks which is musically better, not which can be identified

difference_extent.note: the two readings are uncorrelated inside the window, so the substitution is plainly audible rather than subtle; outside it they are bit-identical, so there is nothing to hear anywhere else

owner_pack.disclosed: everything else, including the edit windows and the join law
owner_pack.focused_excerpts_reason: asking for an A/B over 276 seconds when 266 of them are identical bytes is not a listening task; the focus pair carries the run-up, the edit and the landing

members.A: one of the two full-length readings
members.DONOR_SOURCE: 4:10-4:30, where the inserted material lives; identical in both
members.REVIEW: the question and the admissible outcomes

owner_pack.on_loss_or_tie: close A1-01 as an unsuccessful editing candidate and move Album One to A1-03
owner_pack.on_win: proceed to mastering and A1-01 acceptance; rights eligibility remains a separate decision and is not asked by this pack

source_binding.rebind_note: the historical container itself was recovered, so no dependent container had to be regenerated under a new source identity

locations_kind: the original EarCrate workspace external targets
a frozen shard in that workspace
redundancy.note: the search swept every fixed drive for the exact byte length and then hashed each hit; four copies matched the container digest under two different filenames, so the binding does not depend on one surviving file and the recovery was not a lucky find

state.rights_eligibility: not_evaluated, and not asked by this pack

why_the_excerpt_is_not_the_review.disposition: retained in the pack as a disclosed diagnostic, not as a candidate
why_the_excerpt_is_not_the_review.excerpt_can_answer: whether this one substitution and its entry seam work
why_the_excerpt_is_not_the_review.excerpt_cannot_answer: whether A1-01 functions as a track, because it never exposes the phrase continuity, development or payoff that the edit has to survive
why_the_excerpt_is_not_the_review.excerpt_covers: eight retained bars into a four-bar donor recurrence

witness_reproduction.claim: the retained 31-second object rebuilds bit-for-bit from the bound source
witness_reproduction.record_digest_note: the candidate JSON record digest differs because it carries build context; the audio is identical, and the audio is the claim being made
